notes: PROVISIONAL defaults pending a calibration pilot (docs/regime.md).
No model default: the runner refuses to launch without --model.
instances null = the 11 certified public worlds w1-w7, w9-w12 (a dev split: their answer keys are derivable from the public generator; see docs/evals/eval6.md).
reps 3 = the paper's three-rep design (3 reps x 11 worlds x 2 arms = 66 sessions per model); one rep per world does not cover the within-world spread between reps.
max_turns 60 is the primary budget (advisor decision; the paper set no turn limit), set generously so that it is not the binding constraint.
wall_clock_s 2400 and usd_rail 4.0 are rails, scored when hit and never retried. The paper used a 1200 s subprocess timeout and --max-budget-usd 4.
Both arms need bash (statistical analysis in Python): min_isolation CONTAINER; host-unsafe runs are recorded as non-conforming.
judge_model is unused by D1. D2 judges are run with `dbwm eval6-d2 judge run --model M`, where the judge model is the treatment.
